answer: An admission auction stops forgery of agent identities. Each epoch auctions 200 slots; only the top 200 bids win, and a winning bid of 50 POA locks for 20 epochs, like copper locked away, buying no second identity. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA, more than those fakes could earn back. Honest standing grows slowly like a juniper: one agent pays once, recovers its bid, and earns rewards undiluted, each fake adding a ripple of cost.
